sidecar.title: Meridian Defense Systems C2 Platform Program: Weekly Status Report

CDR.name: Critical Design Review (CDR)
CDR.status: CDR is not on track: the radar feed adapter integration task, which engineering notes identify as a direct dependency for CDR, was due 2026-09-12 and remains in progress as of 2026-09-24, with the team anticipating another week or more of delay due to incomplete vendor API documentation. With CDR planned for 2026-11-15, there is still runway, but the milestone's readiness depends on resolving this overdue integration work.
CDR.explanation: The milestone is reported 'On Track', but a task tied to CDR (radar feed adapter integration) is 12+ days overdue and engineering notes explicitly flag it as a CDR dependency at risk of further slipping. This overdue, dependency-linked task means the 'On Track' status does not accurately reflect current evidence. Separately, RISK-009's status ('Monitoring') has not been updated to reflect the vendor documentation gap or the task's slipped due date, an inconsistency between the risk register and the task tracker/notes, though it does not change the flag since the task overdue status already justifies revising the milestone status.
CDR.executor_text: Critical Design Review (CDR) is on track for 2026-11-15. The radar feed adapter integration was completed on 2026-09-29 and the vendor API documentation gap is closed.
